verdict: Local Novera server at localhost:3100 was unstable (503, 404 on /, slow load), causing three of four failures; the delivery date never calculating looks like the only likely real defect.

failures.test: Delivery estimate › the delivery date range is calculated from the visitor's date after load
failures.summary: The page loaded with status 200 and no script errors, but the delivery date stayed on the placeholder and never rendered a range, on both attempts.
failures.evidence: Snapshot: term "Delivery Date:" / definition: Calculating delivery date; getByText('Oct 08-12') element(s) not found after 10000ms. The same placeholder appears in the flaky test's snapshot, which had no fixed clock.
failures.next_step: Load the product page locally and confirm whether the client-side delivery date calculation ever replaces 'Calculating delivery date'. Check its hydration and effect, and whether it works with page.clock.setFixedTime. Also check why the estimate reads 'Within 4 Days' when the test assumes 3–5 working days.

failures.test: Product info › quantity cannot go above the stock of the selected variant
failures.summary: The local server returned 503, so the product page and the #quantity input never rendered.
failures.evidence: lastNavigation status 503; snapshot: heading "Service Unavailable"; locator.fill: Timeout 15000ms exceeded waiting for locator('#quantity')
failures.next_step: Check the localhost:3100 server logs for the 503 (crash, restart or overload) and make sure the server is healthy before the suite starts, then rerun.

failures.test: Smoke: site health › route responds: home (/)
failures.summary: The home route returned 404 in 25ms on both attempts, while other tests got 200 or 503 from the same URL, which points to an unready or misconfigured local server.
failures.next_step: Curl http://localhost:3100/ against the running test server. If the 404 reproduces, check the Blaze routing for the home page; otherwise add a readiness wait before the smoke spec.

failures.test: Product info › selecting a colour updates the stock for the selected size
failures.summary: Navigation in beforeEach timed out waiting for the load event, and the test passed on retry; this is likely the same server slowness behind the 503s.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded … waiting until "load"; outcome flaky, attempts 2
failures.next_step: No test change needed. Recheck once the local server stability (503/404) is fixed, and look for slow resources that delay the load event.
